data.name: DropDownsDescription
data.value: A native drop-down list bound to a typed value: empty entry, groups, disabled options, and any value type.

data.name: DropDownsSettingsDescription
data.value: Each setting applies to the preview below.

data.name: DropDownsAllowEmptyDescription
data.value: Adds an empty entry at the top that sets the value back to null.

data.name: DropDownsPlaceholderDescription
data.value: Only shown when empty is allowed. Left blank, the control uses its own text.

data.name: DropDownsGroupedDescription
data.value: Each option carries a group: the list files them under headings.

data.name: DropDownsDisableOptionDescription
data.value: Luxembourg stays visible but cannot be chosen.

data.name: DropDownsFilterableDescription
data.value: A search field comes before the list and narrows it as you type.

data.name: DropDownsDisabledDescription
data.value: The whole control is greyed out and ignores input.

data.name: AutocompleteDescription
data.value: A search field that queries an asynchronous source as you type, with debounce, cancellation and explicit selection.

data.name: AutocompleteSettingsDescription
data.value: The source is a list of European cities searched in memory, with a simulated delay.

data.name: AutocompleteShowToggleDescription
data.value: A chevron at the end of the field opens the whole list without typing; a click or the focus on the field opens it too.

data.name: AutocompleteDebounceDescription
data.value: Pause after the last keystroke before the search starts.

data.name: AutocompleteMinimumLengthDescription
data.value: Number of characters to type before anything is searched.

data.name: AutocompleteLatencyDescription
data.value: Time the fake service takes to answer; a new keystroke cancels the pending search.

data.name: AutocompleteHighlightDescription
data.value: The typed letters are marked in each suggestion, ignoring case and accents.

data.name: AutocompleteDisableClosedDescription
data.value: Some results are listed but cannot be picked.

data.name: AutocompleteFailureDescription
data.value: The search throws: the field shows its error message.

data.name: AutocompleteDisabledDescription
data.value: The field is greyed out and ignores input.

data.name: MultiSelectDescription
data.value: Several values at once in a compact single-line control with search and templates; the always-open list is an OmniListBox with Multiple.

data.name: MultiSelectSettingsDescription
data.value: Settings of the control in the live preview.

data.name: MultiSelectFilterableDescription
data.value: Narrows the options to those containing the typed text.

data.name: MultiSelectPlaceholderDescription
data.value: Text of the closed control while nothing is selected.

data.name: MultiSelectFilterPlaceholderDescription
data.value: Replaces the default label of the search field; needs the search field.

data.name: MultiSelectCloseOutsideDescription
data.value: A click elsewhere on the page closes the panel; a click in these settings does not count.

data.name: MultiSelectDisableOptionDescription
data.value: Luxembourg stays listed but cannot be ticked.

data.name: MultiSelectDisabledDescription
data.value: The whole control is greyed out.

data.name: ListsDescription
data.value: Two always-open lists: a list box for a single value, a check box list for several.

data.name: ListsSettingsDescription
data.value: The settings apply to both lists of the preview when they support them.

data.name: ListsVisibleRowsDescription
data.value: Height of the list box, in rows.

data.name: ListsShowLegendDescription
data.value: The check box list titles its group; hidden, it keeps an accessible name.

data.name: ListsDisableOptionDescription
data.value: Lille and the certified copy stay visible but inert.

data.name: RadioButtonsDescription
data.value: One choice among a few, every option always visible: the list builds its buttons from options.

data.name: RadioButtonsSettingsDescription
data.value: The settings apply to the list built from options.

data.name: RadioButtonsShowLegendDescription
data.value: The list titles its group; hidden, it keeps an accessible name.

data.name: RadioButtonsDisableOptionDescription
data.value: Agency pickup stays visible but cannot be chosen.

data.name: RadioButtonsDisabledDescription
data.value: The whole group is greyed out.

data.name: ColorsDescription
data.value: A native colour picker that only accepts #RRGGBB and never produces an inline style.

data.name: ColorsDisabledDescription
data.value: The picker is greyed out and cannot be opened.

data.name: ColorsPresetsDescription
data.value: Sets the bound value from the page, as a program would.

data.name: ColorsSettingsDescription
data.value: The settings apply to the preview picker.

data.name: ColorsShowValueDescription
data.value: Writes the hexadecimal code next to the swatch.

data.name: DatesDescription
data.value: The native date and date-time pickers, bound to DateOnly and DateTime, with bounds and optional seconds.

data.name: DatesMaximumDescription
data.value: Later dates are refused. Empty the field to remove the bound.

data.name: DatesMinimumDescription
data.value: Earlier dates are refused. Empty the field to remove the bound.

data.name: DatesReadOnlyDescription
data.value: The value is shown and can be copied but not changed.

data.name: DatesSettingsDescription
data.value: The bounds apply to both pickers of the preview; the date-time picker takes the whole last day.

data.name: DatesShowSecondsDescription
data.value: Date-time picker only: the time is entered to the second.

data.name: SelectableCardsDescription
data.value: Selectable cards: a choice that deserves more than a radio button, with an icon, a title and a line of explanation.

data.name: SelectableCardsDescriptionsDescription
data.value: The muted line under the title of each card.

data.name: SelectableCardsDisabledDescription
data.value: Every card of the group keeps its state and ignores clicks.

data.name: SelectableCardsGalleryHint
data.value: Outside a group, a card binds a boolean; a disabled card keeps its state.

data.name: SelectableCardsLayoutHint
data.value: Multiple-choice cards draw a check box, can be laid out in columns or drop the check box; the three groups share one list.

data.name: SelectableCardsMultipleDescription
data.value: The cards become check boxes and the group binds a list of values.

data.name: SelectableCardsOptionsHint
data.value: The group draws one card per option: its text as the title, a disabled option as a disabled card.

data.name: SelectableCardsSettingsDescription
data.value: The card group of the preview.

data.name: SelectBarDescription
data.value: A row of joined buttons for a short, exclusive choice, built from options.

data.name: SelectBarDisableOptionDescription
data.value: The quarter and the map view stay visible but cannot be chosen.

data.name: SelectBarItemsHint
data.value: IconFor places an icon beside the text of each option.

data.name: SelectBarOptionCountDescription
data.value: How many periods the bar offers; a value that leaves the bar falls back to the first.

data.name: SelectBarSettingsDescription
data.value: The settings apply to the preview bars.

data.name: SliderDescription
data.value: A range slider bound to a double: bounds, step, orientation and a formatter for the displayed value.

data.name: SliderDisabledDescription
data.value: The slider is greyed out and cannot be moved.

data.name: SliderFormatDescription
data.value: FormatValue turns the number into text, for the label and screen readers.

data.name: SliderMaximumDescription
data.value: Highest value of the preview slider.

data.name: SliderMinimumDescription
data.value: Lowest value of the preview slider.

data.name: SliderSelectableHint
data.value: The track keeps its full length but refuses the positions below the selectable minimum.

data.name: SliderSettingsDescription
data.value: Moving a bound brings the value back inside it before the next render.

data.name: SliderShowValueDescription
data.value: Writes the formatted value next to the slider.

data.name: UploadAcceptDescription
data.value: Filters the file dialog and refuses the other types.

data.name: UploadDescription
data.value: A drop zone that checks the count, size and type of files, as a single-file field and as a several-file field whose list grows and shrinks one line at a time. This page sends nothing: it only reads what the browser says about the chosen files.

data.name: UploadDisabledDescription
data.value: The file field is greyed out.

data.name: UploadEmptyFileDescription
data.value: The component checks count, size and type itself; an empty file is refused by the host, in the Upload callback, with a message that the field shows as its error.

data.name: UploadMaximumFilesDescription
data.value: Several-file field: the whole list, files already attached included, never goes beyond this.

data.name: UploadMaximumSizeDescription
data.value: Per file: a larger file makes the whole selection refused.

data.name: UploadSettingsDescription
data.value: The settings apply to both fields. The checks run in the browser, on metadata supplied by the client: they never replace a server check.
